sources.rights_notes: Official institutional history based on cited NARA and military personnel records. Only short excerpts and project-authored paraphrases are retained.

organizations.normalization_notes: Army service is modeled as a military assignment, not civilian employment. A narrower unit is not inferred when the source names only the Army.
The historical wording used by the reviewed source is preserved. No modern successor name or narrower Canadian training establishment is inferred.

affiliations.date_precision: Army entry is explicit to the day; OSS recruitment is explicit to September 1943 but not a day
affiliations.research_notes: The official history gives a bounded U.S. Army-to-OSS sequence. It does not name Bangsboll's Army unit, so none is inferred.

affiliations.date_precision: Joined after the outbreak of war; the source does not give an entry date; U.S. Army entry is explicit on 22 March 1943
affiliations.research_notes: This Allied military assignment preceded U.S. Army service, which in turn preceded OSS recruitment. It is not a civilian employer.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Leif Bangsboll is the U.S. Army and OSS veteran documented by the U.S. Army Special Operations Command History Office.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official institutional history cites Bangsboll's exact Box 34, Entry 224 NARA personnel folder and reconstructs the matching rank chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the rare exact name, explicit OSS service, Army rank sequence, and direct citation to the same surname folder and Box 34 represented by the index row.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source dates Army entry, OSS recruitment, and later commissioning, explaining how the indexed first-lieutenant rank fits the same person.
claims.match_notes: The project has not directly inspected the physical Box 34 file; confirmation rests on an authoritative history whose notes identify that exact archival file.

claims.claim_text: Leif Bangsboll's best-supported immediate pre-OSS affiliation was the United States Army.
claims.evidence_excerpt: volunteered for the U.S. Army on 22 March 1943 ... In September 1943, the OSS recruited Bangsboll
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official history places Bangsboll in the U.S. Army from 22 March 1943 and records his OSS recruitment that September.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the official history's direct linkage to Bangsboll's indexed Box 34 personnel folder.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded: U.S. Army entry is exact and OSS recruitment is dated to September 1943, with no intervening affiliation reported.
claims.match_notes: Model as military assignment, not civilian employment. The source does not name an Army unit, so the organization remains at service level.

sources.excerpt_override: volunteered for the U.S. Army on 22 March 1943 ... In September 1943, the OSS recruited Bangsboll

claims.claim_text: Before entering the U.S. Army, Leif Bangsboll served as a flight sergeant with the Norwegian Air Force in exile in Canada.
claims.evidence_excerpt: joined the Norwegian Air Force (in exile) in Canada as a flight sergeant
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official history places Bangsboll with the exiled Norwegian air force in Canada before his March 1943 U.S. Army entry.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the rare name and direct archival-file linkage in the same official institutional history.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented before U.S. Army entry and therefore before OSS, but not immediate because U.S. Army service intervened.
claims.match_notes: Model as an Allied military assignment, not an employer. The source gives no exact entry date or narrower Canadian unit.

sources.excerpt_override: joined the Norwegian Air Force (in exile) in Canada as a flight sergeant

claims.claim_text: Leif Bangsboll worked in the merchant marine before his wartime military service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: trained as an observer prior to joining the merchant marine
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official history records merchant-marine work after Bangsboll's 1935 Danish naval-air training and before his Norwegian wartime service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the official history's direct linkage to the indexed Box 34 personnel folder.
claims.temporal_assessment: Definitely pre-OSS and pre-U.S.-Army, but not immediate; the Norwegian Air Force and U.S. Army intervened.
claims.match_notes: Publish as occupation only. The source does not name a shipping company, vessel, or employer, and none is inferred.
